title: Discovery of DMT's effects by Stephen Szára, who injected himself and then colleagues

tellings.quote: DMT was discovered in 1956 by this Hungarian physician uh called Steven Zara.

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, tells how the effects of DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, were discovered in 1956. He says a Hungarian physician named Stephen Szára, working in a hospital in communist Hungary, injected himself with it and then tried it on colleagues. Gallimore tells it as the start of the modern study of the drug's strange visions.
